premise: Bee is so tired her hum goes quiet; Butterfly and Mushroom hum her song for her while she rests, and in the morning all three sing.
inspiration: Aesop's The Ant and the Grasshopper, turned: the singers do not scold the worker; they carry her song while she rests.
lesson: Friends carry each other when one is tired.

en-US.title: Bee Loses Her Hum
en-US.text: {sfx:evening} Every day, {bee:enter} Bee {bee:float loop 0.3} hummed while she worked. Hmm-hmm-bzzz, hmm-hmm-bzzz. It was the sound of the whole meadow. {canvas:sunset 0.6 22s} But one evening, Bee was so tired that her hum went quiet. {bee:face sad} [sad] She tried… and only a tiny bz came out. {butterfly:enter} {bee:tint #BFD4FF} Butterfly {butterfly:pulse} noticed at once. The meadow is too quiet, she said. [curious] {mushroom:enter} Mushroom, can you hum? Mushroom {mushroom:wobble} had never hummed before. But she tried. Mmmm. Butterfly tried too. Hmm-hmm. [softly] And together they hummed Bee's song for her, hmm-hmm-bzzz, slow and sleepy, {bee:face sleeping} while Bee rested. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 10s} By morning, Bee {bee:face happy} {bee:sparkle} felt bright again. [happily] {sfx:buzz} BZZZ! she sang. And this time, {butterfly:face happy} {mushroom:face happy} all three of them sang together. {bee:hearts} {butterfly:hearts} {mushroom:hearts}

es-ES.title: Abeja pierde su zumbido
es-ES.text: {sfx:evening} Todos los días, {bee:enter} Abeja {bee:float loop 0.3} zumbaba mientras trabajaba. Mm-mm-bzzz, mm-mm-bzzz. Era el sonido de todo el prado. {canvas:sunset 0.6 22s} Pero una tarde, Abeja estaba tan cansada que su zumbido se apagó. {bee:face sad} [sad] Lo intentó… y solo le salió un bz chiquitito. {butterfly:enter} {bee:tint #BFD4FF} Mariposa {butterfly:pulse} se dio cuenta enseguida. El prado está demasiado callado, dijo. [curious] {mushroom:enter} Seta, ¿tú sabes zumbar? Seta {mushroom:wobble} nunca había zumbado. Pero lo intentó. Mmmm. Mariposa también lo intentó. Mm-mm. [softly] Y juntas le zumbaron su canción a Abeja, mm-mm-bzzz, lenta y dormilona, {bee:face sleeping} mientras ella descansaba. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 10s} Por la mañana, Abeja {bee:face happy} {bee:sparkle} volvía a estar llena de energía. [happily] {sfx:buzz} ¡BZZZ!, cantó. Y esta vez, {butterfly:face happy} {mushroom:face happy} las tres cantaron juntas. {bee:hearts} {butterfly:hearts} {mushroom:hearts}

evening.prompt: a calm evening meadow, very soft distant insects and a light breeze

buzz.prompt: a bright cheerful bee buzz, strong and happy
